name: Outstanding signatures follow-up list
summary: Twice a week and before month end, whoever sends documents for signature gets one list from the e-signature tool's status export: what is waiting, on whom and for how long, what expires soon, what was declined or expired, and a reminder drafted for each waiting signer. Nothing is sent.

sources.title: FullyPowered AI's own rules for prepared work: the organization's own export and rules as the only authority, fixed inputs that stop on a mismatch, a count that ties to the rows supplied, every gap written as a question, and a person who approves and sends every reminder.
